title: Proot Distro X11 1.2.0
release_notes:
• Display engine rebuilt: TigerVNC's X server (Xvnc) runs INSIDE the app
• Audio out and microphone for guest apps (PulseAudio, per-display bus)
• The viewer is upstream noVNC, verbatim: the keyboard really opens
• Saved presets: name any app command and start it in one tap
• Any CPU architecture: QEMU user-mode bundled for foreign-arch images
• Failures tell the truth (Failed rows, whole-tree Stop, orphan sweep)
• Settings hub, Help screen, bundled license texts and docs
